e2eRoot.description: Directory containing playwright.config.* and the package.json that defines the e2e script. Falls back to the adapter's e2eRoot, then to projectRoot.

projectRoot.description: Target repository root. Used to resolve e2eRoot when e2eRoot is not supplied.

e2eCommand.description: Command used to run the suite. Defaults to 'npm run test:e2e'. The agent appends a JSON reporter override so results are machine-readable.

specs.description: Spec file paths or filename filters to run. Omit to run the entire suite.

grep.description: Playwright --grep pattern to select tests by title.

browsers.description: Playwright project names to run (e.g. chromium, firefox, webkit). Omit to run every project defined in playwright.config.

baseURL.description: Overrides the baseURL from playwright.config. Use when testing a deployed environment instead of the local webServer.

retries.description: Overrides the Playwright retry count. Retries are what allow flaky tests to be detected and reported as high severity.

timeoutSeconds.description: Hard wall-clock limit for the whole suite. On expiry the agent returns status 'blocked' with a timeout blockedReason.

installBrowsers.description: When true, run 'npx playwright install --with-deps' before executing the suite. Needed on clean CI machines.

updateSnapshots.description: When true, pass --update-snapshots so Playwright rewrites its own visual/DOM snapshots. Never combine with a failing run.

specMappings.description: Explicit mapping from Bob test case IDs to Playwright spec titles. When supplied, Susan uses this instead of title matching to adopt E2E results.
